page.lede: {items} results: {exact} exact, {agrees} agree, {partly} partly agree, {differs} differ, {not_attempted} not attempted. The lost method was rebuilt from the paper's Methods, and the seven datasets from GEO, Bioconductor and the GSEA site.
page.items_caption: Every figure, table and claim of the paper. Figure values are read off the published figures (Figs 2 and 3) or the vector supplements (Figs S1 to S5); a value agrees within 0.1 |t| (Fig. 2), 0.02 AUC (Figs 3, S2, S3), 0.05 overlap (Fig. S1) or 50 of 500 classifiers (frequencies).
page.claims_line: The main claim, that classifiers on CORG-based pathway activity beat classifiers on genes, holds in Breast Netherlands, Lung Michigan, Lung Boston and Michigan to Boston. It does not hold in our NF-kB, Prostate, Breast USA, USA to Netherlands and Boston to Michigan runs: our breast and NF-kB data are not the authors' (open), Boston's pathway pre-selection differs (open), and Prostate's small gap has no tested cause beyond the unstated classifier settings.
came_back: All 18 CORG lists and all 18 CORG and member counts, from the GSEA lung files.
The Michigan panels E and F within 0.1 at 36 of 38 points; the breast and Boston source panels keep the paper's order of curves.
Glycolysis and estrogen signalling higher in poor prognosis in both lung datasets.
Michigan to Boston: the paper's eight pathways are our eight most used, in its order but for one swap.
CORG search, pathway activity and Tian's pre-selection, as the Python package pacorg.
buried: The breast data as the authors prepared them: 3 of Table S2's 15 CORG lists come back.
Boston's top pathways: the paper's are not those of Tian's statistic on the GSEA Boston file.
NF-kB: in our 24 arrays every classifier is near perfect; the paper's gene classifier is at 0.82.
How the paper computed the CORG overlap of Fig. S1.
page.matched_intro: How each part of the paper's method was rebuilt.
matched: Each gene z-scored over all samples; a set's activity is the sum of member z-scores over sqrt(k).
Members ranked by t, added while |t| of the activity rises (pooled-variance t).
Tian's statistic as sum of t over sqrt(members), top 52 of 522; the Methods say average t, but Table 1 and Fig. 2 follow the standardized sum.
Logistic regression; markers added in order of p-value, the count chosen by validation AUC; 100 runs of 5-fold CV.
GSEA lung files as distributed; GEO and Bioconductor for the other five, mapped to MSigDB v1.0 symbols through Entrez Gene IDs.
